component.name: qimgv
component.summary: Fast and configurable image viewer with optional video support

description.p: qimgv is a fast, lightweight image viewer with a deliberately uncluttered interface. UI elements appear only when you need them.

ul.li: Fully configurable, including themes and shortcuts
Basic image editing: crop, rotate and resize
Quickly copy or move images to different folders
Video playback via libmpv, including H.265, AV1 and ProRes
Modern image formats: AVIF (including animated), JPEG XL, HEIF, WebP, APNG
Ability to run shell scripts on the current image

screenshot.caption: Main window with the thumbnail panel

description.p: The I key now opens a file info panel showing the file's real format, codec and resolution alongside all of its Exif, IPTC and XMP metadata, read without holding up the interface. Adds a Lock zoom fit mode, and renames "Fit in window (stretch)" to "Stretch to height".

Reading a folder moved off the UI thread, so the window stays responsive while a folder is read; this is what made qimgv unusable on slow network shares. Large folders open and scroll faster, and the transparency grid now applies to video with an alpha channel.
First release of the duckautomata fork. Qt 6 only, rebuilt CMake build system with presets, and expanded codec support including animated AVIF, HEIF and ProRes 4444 with alpha.
